settings.title: Battery data for Google Maps (EV energy model)
settings.description: Sends Maps the battery's real energy, its learned usable capacity, charge curves and the outside temperature every 5 s during Android Auto, for its arrival charge and charging stops. Needs an Android Auto library build this mod supports (Ioniq 5 US 260507 or Ioniq 6 US 260903).

settings.title: Precondition the battery on the way to a DC fast charger
settings.description: When Maps (Android Auto) guides to a charging stop, asks the car to warm or cool the battery, with the real distance and time to it (the thresholds are below). Off too when the car's own Battery Conditioning setting is off. Needs the route data the Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto mod's turn-by-turn adds.

settings.title: Precondition for chargers faster than (kW)
settings.description: Maps' charging stops above this power count (0-400; 50 by default, so DC fast chargers only). Applies at once, to the current route too.

settings.title: Start when the charger is this many minutes away
settings.description: By Maps' remaining time (5-180; 60 by default). The car's battery system then times the heating from the distance and time it's sent. HMG-API stops a request if the car's indicator isn't on within 2 minutes, and automatic starts then wait for a manual one, so a shorter window (20-30) is safer until HMG-API lets a routed request wait for the car.

settings.title: Arrived within (metres)
settings.description: Closer than this to the charger, preconditioning stops and doesn't start (50-2000; 200 by default).

settings.title: Starts per route at most
settings.description: If the car keeps ending the request (1-10; 3 by default).

settings.title: Battery level, range and odometer for Android Auto apps
settings.description: Sends the battery %, the range the cluster shows and the odometer to the phone every 5 s during Android Auto, as Android Auto's fuel and odometer data. Apps that read the car's data, such as A Better Route Planner, show the live battery level. Needs no library patch.

settings.title: EV logs
settings.description: Logs battery, charging, climate and Maps' route plan whenever the head unit is on (no location or time of day). Copied to any USB drive that has an egmp-aa-ev-logs folder.
